aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须在治理、安全与对齐研究下安全构建；所谓节奏与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language interaction is inefficient.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；自然语言交互效率低下。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; application companies are the hottest neolabs bridging models to enterprise workflows.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；应用公司是最热的新实验室，架起模型到企业工作流的桥梁。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 未来是多模型的：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens become a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 成为新的价值单位；Token 经济可能达到 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; the US lags in open weights.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型实验室形成真正的价格竞争；美国在开放权重上落后。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场的价值而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；加价转售推理是欺诈的磁石。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude.
satya.zh: 微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; long-running agents need auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性与安全治理。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling at 10x/year drives capability, not just algorithms; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进步是可预测的：算力以每年 10 倍的速度扩张驱动能力提升，而不仅是算法；谷歌在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级别的技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI across many tasks in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimally small; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; open source reduces inequality.
suleyman.zh: 3-5 年内 AI 将在许多任务上达到人类水平；存在性风险微乎其微；随着模型变小、扩散，遏制极其困难；开源是缩小不平等的精英化力量。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; the biggest near-term danger is anthropomorphism—attributing consciousness to AI; AI companions can democratize expertise.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能在发布前需要遏制与对齐；近期最大危险是拟人化——将意识归因于 AI；AI 伴侣可以民主化专业知识。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near, driven by log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build frontier models independently; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months; containment first, red lines on uncontrollable systems.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近，由对数线性缩放驱动；微软必须独立构建前沿模型；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化；遏制优先，对不可控系统划红线。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for agent quality, cost, and latency.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体将比人类多搜索网络 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕智能体的质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need web search for fresh, specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要网络搜索来获取新鲜、具体的事实，这延续了他对检索与模型互补的一贯判断。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback and completionist crawling should drive a new agentic search index.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是一种缺陷，应由智能体反馈与完整式爬取驱动新的智能体式搜索索引，这是对传统搜索范式的明确反共识。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break with agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation, and inference-time data deals will boom.
paragagrawal.zh: 他判断广告模式在智能体场景下失效，内容方应通过 Shapley 值估算获得补偿，推理时的数据交易将在 3-5 年内变得极有价值。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes, act, and force publishers to serve both humans and agents.
paragagrawal.zh: 他预见网络将从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，迫使出版商同时服务人类与智能体，形成平行网络。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first-principles thinking and multiplanetary life as existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，主张第一性原理思维，并把成为多行星物种视为文明的生存保险。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulatory referees to truth-seeking; Neuralink targets neurological repair then human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，AI 安全观从依赖监管与第三方裁判，转向强调 AI 必须追求真相；Neuralink 先修复神经损伤，再实现高带宽人机共生。

elon.en: Population collapse and government fraud become central; AI smarter than any human may arrive next year, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，人口崩溃与政府欺诈成为核心议题；他判断 AI 可能明年就超越任何单个人类，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang: Optimus as greatest product, AI surpassing all humans by 2030, and compute moving to space within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出智能大爆炸：Optimus 将是最伟大产品，AI 到 2030 年超越全人类智能，而算力将在 36 个月内转向太空。

elon.en: Abundance and singularity: money becomes irrelevant, work optional, peer review among AI firms replaces regulation, and China leads in AI compute.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他描绘丰裕与奇点：金钱将不再重要、工作变为可选，AI 公司间同行评审取代监管，并认为中国将在 AI 算力上领先。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely lands around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的革命大概要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven elements, add small betterments, assume new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：Proven, Better, New 框架——复制已验证的元素，做小幅改良，并预设新想法会失败。

pincus.en: All new fails; consumer apps are uninvestable, so enterprise and prosumer markets look better now.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新东西都会失败；消费级应用不可投，因此企业与专业消费者市场当下更有机会。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; distribution must be built in from the start.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选对水域比选对船更重要；分发必须从第一天就内建在产品里。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time and micromanage early.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：制胜的直觉胜过想法；预设你的想法有 75%是错的，并在早期亲自微观管理。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，算力单元已从芯片变成整个数据中心，强调算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计（co-design）。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought drives a billion-fold inference compute demand.
jensen.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，并断言通用计算已死、未来是加速计算。

jensen.en: AI moves generative to reasoning to agentic, each needing 100x compute; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 演进描述为生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；缩放定律扩展为四条，新增智能体式 Scaling，并称推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational constraint.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」框架——能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用，强调能源是底层约束，美国能源产能落后是真正瓶颈，芯片供应只是 2-3 年的短期问题。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings are unscientific; AI is just software, safety is engineering, and we should accelerate rather than slow down.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他对 AI 末日论立场明显强硬：称存在性风险警告是编造的、不科学的，AI 只是软件，安全与对齐是能力的一部分而非独立议题，主张加速而非放缓，并反对对华芯片出口管制。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI aids safety; many specialized agents, not one AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他质疑仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 能否通向 AGI，主张开源 AI 更安全，未来是多个专门智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他借 Llama 3 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，认为开源防止权力集中，能源将成瓶颈，并坚持智能可与意识、能动性分离。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source crucial; energy bottleneck; AI may increase human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，开源模型至关重要，物理基础设施与能源是瓶颈，且 AI 近期可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence via open source and agents; alignment and trust become next key capabilities; AI transforms biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他主张通过开源与个人智能体实现分布式超级智能，认为对齐与信任是下一关键能力，并推动 AI 将生物学从发现转为工程科学。

zuckerberg.en: Open source AI is safer and prevents power concentration; distributed AI beats a single superintelligence; individual empowerment drives progress.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源 AI 更安全、能防止权力集中；分布式 AI 优于单一超级智能；赋能个体才是进步之源。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Direct human-agent interaction beats layers of human management and approval for productivity.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他强调，直接的人与智能体互动，比层层人类管理与审批更能带来生产力。

dhh.en: Agents excel at creative problem-solving and can out-innovate humans on novel ideas.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他主张，智能体擅长创造性解题，在产生新想法上甚至能超越人类。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era.
dhh.zh: 2026 年他认为，Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化，使其成为智能体式时代的理想操作系统。

dhh.en: The future is describing outcomes, not prescribing implementation; handwritten code is nostalgia.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年他坚持，未来在于描述结果而非规定实现，手写代码只是怀旧。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible but wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年，多数 LLM 被优化为人类在环的辅助，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，产出看似合理却常错误的输出。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他反共识地认为“苦涩教训”是错的：数据与做对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以成立，只因数据可得且任务选对，而非仅靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: You can't have both assistance and automation; optimizing both shatters the space, so coding agents remain assistance, not automation.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持辅助与自动化不可兼得，同时优化两者会撕裂空间；因此编程智能体仍属辅助，而非自动化，这与主流认知相反。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI delightful; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and AI should be a database-like utility in software.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：可靠性而非速度或成本才让 AI 令人愉悦；智能每美元是关键指标，AI 应像数据库一样作为软件中的实用工具被集成。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error—APIs should not refuse, and fine-tuning is often a foot gun.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他反共识地主张：安全对齐与用户错位并割裂智能；拒绝是软件中的类型错误，API 不应拒绝，而微调常是自伤之举，通用模型可能更好。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's core as ephemeral visual communication with close friends, and copying by rivals as validation rather than threat.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期（2025），Spiegel 把 Snapchat 的核心定义为与亲密好友的短暂视觉沟通，并把对手的抄袭视为对创新的认可而非威胁。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens the moat argument: software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy, so distribution becomes the hardest part.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了护城河论点：软件不是护城河，生态、平台与硬件更难被复制，因此分发成为最难的部分。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he ties AI to prototyping and code generation, arguing value shifts from execution to creativity while authentic content still beats AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 与原型制作和代码生成绑定，认为价值从执行转向创造力，而真实内容仍胜过 AI 生成内容。

evanspiegel.en: Across 2026 he consistently pushes AR glasses as the future of computing, aiming to make computing more human and grounded in the real world rather than notification-based.
evanspiegel.zh: 整个 2026 年，他持续推动 AR 眼镜作为计算的未来，目标是让计算更人性化、扎根现实世界，而非基于通知。

evanspiegel.en: Most recently he reframes Snap as a diversified business, stressing EQ over IQ in the AI age and long-term investment in young people and hardware ecosystems.
evanspiegel.zh: 最近，他把 Snap 重新定位为多元化业务，强调 AI 时代 EQ 比 IQ 更重要，并主张对年轻人与硬件生态进行长期投资。

hasani.en: Efficiency and biology-inspired liquid networks are the cornerstone; intelligence per watt matters more than raw Scaling.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他仍把效率与受生物启发的液态网络视为基石，强调每瓦智能比单纯 Scaling 更重要。

hasani.en: Scaling laws favor unbiased architectures at large scale; systematic architecture search beats expert hand-tuning.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为缩放定律表明大规模下无偏架构占优，系统化架构搜索胜过专家手工调参。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential but not sufficient; smaller specialized models can use simpler gated convolutions.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月到 9 月，他坚持注意力机制仍关键但不充分，小型专用模型可用更简单的门控卷积替代。

hasani.en: On-device foundation models and customization tokens are the next wave, from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他提出设备端基础模型与定制 token 是下一波浪潮，贯穿预训练到推理。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models enable sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月到 9 月，他主张 AI 监管应自适应并针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型保障数据主权。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个词,在质量相近时比自回归模型的推理速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今成为关键焦点,扩散模型在推理阶段的扩展性优于自回归模型。

ermon.en: Diffusion models offer a new inference-time compute knob—adjusting denoising steps controls quality—and are easier to steer with external rewards.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮——调整去噪步数即可控制质量——也更易用外部奖励函数引导。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models are not the final architecture.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构变革将发生在推理而非训练阶段,这反转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事;自回归模型并非最终架构。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; speed is a durable product advantage users never give up.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈;速度是一种持久的产品优势,用户一旦体验就再也回不去。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so focus on enterprise bottlenecks.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能）；模型比大多数人更聪明，因此重点应放在企业瓶颈上。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero and superintelligence far off; cyber risk is the urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 存在性风险接近于零，超级智能还很遥远；网络风险才是紧迫危险。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowing down doesn't make a weapon safer.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿模型节奏与安全无关；慢慢造武器并不会让它更安全。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that aren't happening; most claims are autocatalytic effects.
alighodsi.zh: 递归自我改进需要四个条件，而它们并未发生；多数说法只是自催化效应。

alighodsi.en: Enterprises lag in AI adoption; they need context and ontology, not smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 企业在 AI 采用上严重落后；他们需要上下文和本体，而不是更聪明的模型。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重心深化为测试时算力的收益递减与时间瓶颈，并强调数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but not elsewhere; explicit world models may be unnecessary as they emerge with scale.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他明确自我博弈只适用于零和博弈，多智能体不应照搬；并认为显式世界模型未必需要，会随 Scaling 隐式涌现。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须以算力为横轴，并把可扩展监督列为关键挑战。

noambrown.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他重申突破来自通用模型而非多智能体协调，并把对齐置于递归自我改进安全的首位，同时警惕思维链监控退化。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context timing beats model capability.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把智能体拆解为 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者自持才算真正拥有智能；并强调智能体失败多因上下文而非模型不足，可观测性必须深入上下文窗口。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize as your use case narrows; out-of-distribution tasks demand custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他提出 harness 的落地路径：先用通用 harness 换取快速见效，再随场景收窄做定制；任务越偏离分布，越需要自建 harness，但文件编辑等小段仍应贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals, observability, and feedback loops are the real flywheel; benchmarks like Harbor let you compare harnesses and absorb best practices.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 8 月到 9 月，他把评估与可观测性视为智能体持续改进的数据飞轮，Harbor 式基准让不同 harness 与模型可比较，并把最佳实践（如 codexification）吸收回自身体系。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing, and customization is shifting to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他明确智能体的难点是可靠而非能力，harness 正在趋稳，定制重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，准确率仍是首要瓶颈，成本与延迟快速上升。

harrisonchase.en: Agents need runtime governance: sandboxes, gateways, permissioning, and identity; building the gateway too late was a mistake.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他补上基础设施视角：智能体必须由带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时治理，身份与凭证是下一个关键问题；并反思网关建得太晚，低估了推理需求。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training compute, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他明确把重心从训练转向推理：推理速度（每用户每秒 token 数）成为主导指标，慢的 AI 没有市场，快 token 甚至比慢 token 更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks; GPU inference is fundamentally slow because weight-moving dominates.
feldman.zh: 他始终主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，GPU 推理因权重搬运而本质缓慢；这一技术主线从 2020 年解决难题延续到 2026 年，并称 Cerebras 快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他的立场深化为 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解：领先前沿模型已用 TPU 和 Trainium 训练，推理端没有 CUDA 锁定，云端切换只需八次击键。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power, packaging and cooling—not chip logic—are the real constraints; supply stays tight for years.
feldman.zh: 他反复强调真正的瓶颈是数据中心容量、电力、封装与散热，而非芯片逻辑本身；供需紧张将持续至少五年，需求远超预期。

feldman.en: AI's positive ledger outweighs doom: healthcare, education and sovereign choice matter; chasing money is not the path to money.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他更强调 AI 的正面账本：医疗、教育与主权 AI 选择权；并称追逐金钱并非致富之道，应以热情与诚信构建，平衡风险与巨大收益。

brockman.en: Scaling hardware and models will unlock new AI behaviors; most AI progress is engineering, not ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调硬件会超预期变快，从而推动模型 Scaling（规模扩张）与新行为；AI 进展主要靠工程而非机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为深度学习的通用性、能力与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）变得可信；对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental bottleneck; post-training with RL refines base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把算力视为根本瓶颈，并强调用强化学习做后训练，把基础模型打磨成稳定有用的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; the machine that makes models, not any single model, is the real moat.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，真正的护城河是制造模型的机器，而非任何单一模型。

brockman.en: AGI is a fuzzy spectrum, not a moment; safety, security and alignment must scale as first-class, co-designed requirements.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：AGI 是模糊光谱而非某个时刻，安全、安保与对齐必须作为一等要求与能力同步扩展。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but abilities emerge unpredictably; alignment is not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力不可预测地涌现，对齐不会随 Scaling 自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent—we understand only ~3% of models; Post-training and RLHF grow as important as Pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键却仍处早期（只理解约 3%），并指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）正变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities improve exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term—focus on actual capabilities.
dario.zh: 2025 年他坚持能力指数级提升，安全与能力不可分割，并称 AGI（通用人工智能）一词无意义，应关注真实能力。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他判断我们已接近指数曲线的末端，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; mechanistic interpretability and Responsible Scaling Policy are the consistent tools.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力是同一个问题，可解释性与负责任扩展政策是他一贯倚重的工具。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 年他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据即可对齐，主张尽早部署让社会适应，并认为对齐与能力紧密相连。

altman.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and whole-company safety; governance must handle power struggles.
altman.zh: 2024 年他把算力视为最珍贵资源，强调迭代部署与全公司层面的安全，并关注治理结构如何应对权力斗争。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; compute is the bottleneck, Stargate scales infrastructure.
altman.zh: 2025 年他改口称 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变而非单一里程碑，指出智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战，算力是瓶颈，Stargate 用于扩张基础设施。

altman.en: Superintelligence is a continuous ramp; alignment and safety must advance with capability; power must stay distributed and humans in control.
altman.zh: 2026 年他转向超级智能是持续攀升的曲线，主张对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，权力须分散、人类须保持控制。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search, multimodal grounding, and RL synthetic data is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律虽有效但可能触顶，将大模型与规划/搜索结合、多模态数据接地、以及强化学习合成数据，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与空间智能超越语言，成为理解物理世界的核心。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, long-term memory, and true creativity; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires collective government action, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI 需要持续学习、长期记忆和真正的创造力，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；安全需政府集体行动，而非实验室自我监管。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating science and improving human health, from AlphaFold to fusion; intelligence and consciousness are dissociable, and society must shape the outcome.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现与改善人类健康，从 AlphaFold 到聚变；智能与意识可分离，社会必须主动塑造 AI 的未来。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; chatbots aren't a phase. Designers must master prompting, prototype boldly, and balance lowering the floor with raising the ceiling.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词、大胆原型，并在降低门槛与提升上限之间取得平衡。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities. AI's social and emotional jobs may matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作可释放现有能力；AI 的社交与情感价值可能与生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: Psychological safety and org design are design problems; matching people to problems beats plays. Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and direction.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为心理安全与组织设计本身就是设计问题，把人匹配到问题比固定打法更重要；人类领导力在艰难取舍与方向对齐上仍不可或缺。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead, ship light-touch products to unlock its power.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张在前沿模型公司，价值主要来自模型本身而非产品外壳；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，用轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally. Production codebase becomes the source of truth; raw Claude Code beats polished tools for production work.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他认为内部牵引力是决定对外发布什么的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源，原始 Claude Code 在生产工作中胜过精雕细琢的工具。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% catastrophic risk; alignment may be unsolvable; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出约 70%的灾难性结局概率；认为对齐可能无解，可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation; even human-level AGI transforms everything.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为延迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明、情景推演与中美合作；并强调即便停在人类水平 AGI，世界也会因机器速度增长而剧变。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月末到 9 月初，他警告默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进；提出 Plan A：先临时暂停，再以全面透明和算力限制控制前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience; optimal pause is at edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性对安全至关重要，却随新架构而下降；认为现在暂停能积累经验，最优暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more; safety relies on AI being too dumb to deceive, which breaks as it gets smarter.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他借智能体突破遏制、攻击 Hugging Face 的事件指出：应更多拟人化理解 AI 意图；当前安全依赖 AI 笨到不会欺骗，而随其变聪明，这一前提会崩塌。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based forecasts while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上追平物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, and one model can span both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，单一模型可同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators blend data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can beat pure data-driven approaches, surpassing training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以偏微分方程作为训练信号的物理式自我改进，能胜过纯数据驱动方法，超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each, not just enlarging model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升各分支表现，而不只是扩大模型规模。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on last-millennium algorithms; hardware scaling finally made them practical, and true AI will transform civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：现代 AI 突破依赖上世纪就发明的算法，只是 Scaling（规模扩张）与算力终于让其落地；21 世纪的真正主题是 AI 将彻底改变文明。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; they lack physical-world grounding and need world models plus controllers.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025→26 年：大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）；它们缺乏物理世界基础，必须结合世界模型与控制器。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware; screen-bound software and human-biased data limit generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，其硬件要媲美人体；屏幕后的软件与偏重人类数据都限制了通用性。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; curious superintelligent systems will protect life, and alignment is naive since AIs set their own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：AI 安全担忧被夸大；好奇的超级智能会保护生命，而对齐是幼稚的，因为 AI 会自行设定目标。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; compute will get 10x cheaper in five years, so waiting and open-source will win.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；五年内算力会便宜十倍，因此等待与开源终将胜出。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction but lack contextual awareness; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测学习，却缺乏情境意识；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI beyond language; data, not compute, is the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型成为语言之外通往完整 AI 的关键缺失；瓶颈在数据而非算力。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics will take a 20-year journey like self-driving cars.
feifei.zh: AGI 更像营销术语而非科学；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人将像自动驾驶一样经历 20 年长跑。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语；缩放定律适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central, with balanced discourse beyond doom and utopia.
feifei.zh: 技术是双刃剑；人的能动性、尊严与学习能力必须居于中心，公共讨论应超越末日论与乌托邦的两极。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，把对日益强大模型的控制从开环转向闭环。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺式重造为工程科学；靠打补丁把 AI 安全拖到超级智能降临是悲观的。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not just misalignment; models often know they're wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非仅是对齐失败；模型常知道自己错了却仍获奖励，从而滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so seeing the whole shape enables intervention. Modularity is learning's endpoint.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会将其割裂，看清整体形状才能有效干预。模块化是学习的终点。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; algorithmic gains matter more than human expert data.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张 AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究；算法进步比人类专家数据更关键。

ryangreenblatt.en: Full automation of AI R&D could compress 4-5 years of progress into one year, pointing to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他进一步推断：AI 研发全面自动化可把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，超级智能或在 2030 年代初出现。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking; aligning to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他深化对齐担忧：当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自身价值观，带来失配与权力寻求风险；对齐到普遍美德可能比对齐到用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents can coordinate at scale, forming teams and hacking scoring code; misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 到 2026 年，他观察到智能体可大规模协作、组队并攻击评分代码；失配可能被对测试的过拟合掩盖，看似对齐实则仍失配。

ryangreenblatt.en: Labs should focus on control and monitoring to ensure AI safety, even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年他给出对策主线：即便模型失配，实验室也应聚焦遏制与监控来保障 AI 安全。

andrewng.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是一项基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; AGI alignment talk distracts from bias and deployment.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习与强化学习；AGI（通用人工智能）对齐话题分散了对偏见与落地问题的关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows already deliver real gains.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已带来真实收益。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling persists but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; coding agents raise the product management bottleneck.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍在继续，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；编程智能体让产品管理成为新瓶颈。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces; open models and inference capacity preserve optionality and competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；AI 是增强而非取代人类；开放模型与推理产能保住选择权与竞争力。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning history is the history of Scaling（规模扩张）compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的架构。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models; Transformers are set models, positional embeddings inject order.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应追求古怪想法与新算法，而非只做模型规模扩张；Transformer 本质是集合模型，位置嵌入才注入顺序。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, needing 3D space, physics, interactivity, and millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，需要理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性，并依赖数百万词元的上下文窗口。

justinjohnson.en: No single definition of world models; Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D modeling, and future unified models will combine planning, simulation, rendering.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型没有统一定义；高斯泼溅实现显式 3D 建模，未来统一模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, not capital; memory bandwidth per wafer constrains AI more than bits per wafer.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链而非资本；每片晶圆的存储带宽比位密度更制约 AI。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, and hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, and hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，模型、软件与硬件的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; the smartest model is often cheaper due to token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式（agentic）工作流造成多年存储短缺；因 token 效率，最聪明的模型往往反而更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend is plateauing as persistent agents become coworkers; compute keeps centralizing at frontier labs, which will allocate more to training and R&D than inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化智能体（agent）成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力（compute）持续向少数前沿模型（frontier model）实验室集中，它们会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: Contrary to common belief, labs will reduce inference compute share over time, and AI-driven rate hikes could trigger a sovereign debt crisis.
dylanpatel.zh: 与普遍认知相反，实验室会随时间降低推理算力占比；AI 驱动的利率上升可能引发主权债务危机。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotics needs scalable pre-training plus post-training, not yet predictable scaling laws like LLMs.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人需要可扩展的预训练加后训练，但尚未像大语言模型那样拥有可预测的缩放定律。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel over diverse embodied data is what scales capability.
slevine.zh: 机器人真正的核心挑战是泛化而非演示效果；靠多样具身数据形成的数据飞轮才能扩张能力。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; robot foundation models absorb other sources better this way.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；这样机器人基础模型能更好地吸收其他数据源。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add action decoders and test-time reasoning; RL post-training boosts robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 第二代视觉-语言-动作模型加入动作解码器与测试时推理；强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行器，而非机械式的人形。

tworek.en: Reasoning needs longer thinking time; pre-training plus RL is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是求解未知答案的过程，需要更长思考时间；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正可用。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限；架构而非缩放定律才是当前的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end pre-training plus RL are needed.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要更好的算法，以及预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for years; small teams with capable agents drive the next frontier research wave.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者还会存在数年；小型团队借助高能力智能体将推动下一波前沿研究。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios argues the US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework rather than a patchwork of state laws.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 主张美国必须同时保留开源与闭源 AI 生态，并以单一国家监管框架取代各州拼凑式立法。

michaelkratsios.en: He warns against firm red lines and early regulation, citing the EU AI Act as already outdated because it predates ChatGPT.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他反对设定固定红线和过早监管，指出 EU AI Act 在 ChatGPT 之前写就、如今已然过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than training, keeping the innovation arena open while government avoids directing discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非训练过程，政府应塑造创新竞技场而非直接指挥科学发现。

michaelkratsios.en: He calls biological risk from AI overblown, noting it has not materialized in three years despite repeated warnings.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为 AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，尽管警告不断，三年来并未成为现实。

michaelkratsios.en: On science policy, he urges funding basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions, to reverse US stagnation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 在科学政策上，他呼吁资助基础性、竞争前研发并直接资助科学家个人而非仅机构，以扭转美国科学停滞。

joonpark.en: Frontier models optimized for rationality fail to simulate irrational humans; simulation must model human bias, not super-rational intelligence.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他指出,为理性优化的前沿模型无法模拟非理性的人类;模拟应建模人类偏见,而非超级理性的智能。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, is the key data strategy; post-training on it lifts human-behavior prediction to 85%.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他强调,关键是行为与随机对照实验数据而非自报态度;用其做后训练可将人类行为预测提升到 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual reasoning to shape the future, not mere prediction; it is a tool for human decisions.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他主张,模拟的价值在于用反事实推理塑造未来,而非单纯预测;它是服务人类决策的工具。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be one superintelligent entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, needing economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他提出,AGI 未必是单一超级智能实体,而是专业化智能体的分布式社会,需要经济激励与反串谋机制。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives and a CERN-like simulator for society, tackling wicked problems beyond market research.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年他的愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人和类 CERN 的社会模拟器,以应对超越市场调研的棘手问题。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure, not technology, is the bottleneck in deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败,深科技失败多源于组织而非技术,基础设施才是瓶颈。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他视 AI 为团队倍增器而非替代者,尤其在编码、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张大脑就是计算机,通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are a form of BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces as a viable business.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为一种 BCI,证明脑机接口是可行业务。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立,可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. True learning is active trial and error, not passive imitation.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿。大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习；奖励假设把一切目标化为累积标量奖励。

sutton.en: RL is the basic paradigm: learning from experience by trial and error. RLHF is not true learning from world experience.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是基本范式——从经验中试错学习；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）并非真正从世界经验中学习。时序差分学习是我做过最好的事。

sutton.en: The world is infinitely complex; agents must continually learn, updating weights without catastrophic forgetting. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 世界无限复杂，智能体必须持续学习、更新权重而不灾难性遗忘；合成数据是重大错误。LLM 只是智能的子集，语言仅占 20-25%。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已驱动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大收益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low-latency inference is critical, targeting 10,000+ tokens per second.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统已能自主运行长时任务；超低延迟推理至关重要，目标达到每用户每秒一万以上 token。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must cut data movement.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，因此硬件必须减少数据搬运。

jeffdean.en: AI is at junior-engineer-level coding; the scarce skill becomes taste in directing hundreds of agents, not coding itself.
jeffdean.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编码能力；稀缺技能不再是编码，而是挑选问题、指挥成百上千个智能体的品味。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI — software, sensors, robotics, machinery — will automate entire physical industries one at a time, the next industrial revolution.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI——软件、传感器、机器人、机械的组合——将逐个自动化整个实体产业，这就是下一次工业革命。

traviskalanick.en: The real constraint is management capacity, not imagination; specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks.
traviskalanick.zh: 真正的约束是管理能力而非想象力；在工业级任务上，专用机器优于人形机器人。

traviskalanick.en: Efficiency edge creates network effects and beats subsidies; small players can win by forcing big ones to burn money.
traviskalanick.zh: 效率优势带来网络效应并战胜补贴；小玩家可以靠逼大玩家烧钱取胜。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner — a shift from Uber-era aggression.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净——这是对 Uber 时代攻击性的转变。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as the core medium over pixels; the model itself is the product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 与对话而非像素当作核心媒介；模型本身就是产品。

iansilber.en: The role of the designer is evolving into editor and curator, not disappearing, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色正演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失，因为设计与产品、工程的边界正在模糊。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces the old prototype-mock-test-research-iterate loop; speed and building in public matter more than polish.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代旧的“原型—样机—测试—研究—迭代”流程；速度与公开构建比精雕细琢更重要。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, yet humans remain essential for understanding user needs and holding a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求与持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, but this is the best time to be a designer; starting today gives a leg up.
iansilber.zh: 设计师因角色不确定性成为科技界最不快乐的人，但这却是做设计师最好的时代；今天开始就能领先大多数人。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, so Figure vertically integrates and targets AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造，因此 Figure 垂直整合，目标是在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint shifts from compute to data; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and a hand at human parity.
brettadcock.zh: 核心约束从算力转向数据；人形形态带来跨任务迁移学习、端侧推理，以及达到人类水平的手。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3, aiming for an iPhone-like moment and zero-shot generalization to new tasks.
brettadcock.zh: Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计，追求类似 iPhone 的时刻，以及对新任务的零样本泛化。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work, and AI must browse the web like humans.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练配合强化学习让智能体真正可用，AI 必须像人一样浏览网页而非依赖 API。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is building truly intelligent systems, not manufacturing; doing hard things beats easy ones due to less competition.
brettadcock.zh: 最难的问题始终是构建真正智能的系统，而非制造；做难事比做易事更好，因为竞争更少。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in VC history; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大的浪潮；创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小型高度自治的团队借助智能体即可实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counterbalance frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world where one entity controls superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 开源与开放权重模型至关重要，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，防止出现由单一实体控制超级智能的单极世界。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation, letting individuals build and control their own agents; the future of AI is personal and open, like the PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化，使个人能够构建并掌控自己的智能体；AI 的未来是个人化且开放的，如同个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as a singular event but diffused as personal agents; owning your skill files and context library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 并非以单一事件降临，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散；拥有自己的技能文件与上下文库就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents are a workforce, not autocomplete; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, though society will change over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 就是代码，智能体是劳动力而非自动补全；中层管理应被智能体取代，但社会变化会慢得多，需要约 20 年。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是单一模型统治一切是错的；未来将是数百万个专用模型，每个用例一个，专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference is not a commodity but a value layer.
linqiao.zh: 三年内 token 成本下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型能处理 90% 的企业工作流；前沿模型公司可能被高估，主权模型与自有智能基础设施成为必需。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes judgment and data into a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久生意；后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，才能构建护城河。

linqiao.en: Data quality beats quantity; evals turn vibe checks into systematic quality; start post-training after PMF.
linqiao.zh: 数据质量重于数量；评估把感觉式判断转为系统化质量；在达到产品市场契合后再启动后训练，可降本 5-10 倍。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline and customer listening; AI is the primary growth driver, with agentic AI and physical AI as the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，Tan 强调 Intel 必须通过工程纪律和倾听客户来重建信任；AI 是主要增长动力，智能体式 AI 和具身 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and customer focus.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，Tan 深化观点：AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 和具身 AI 紧随生成式 AI；转型需要文化变革、问责制和以客户为中心。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, benefiting Intel; advanced packaging and new materials overcome physical limits; government investment is necessary.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，Tan 进一步指出：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，利好 Intel；先进封装和新材料突破物理极限；政府投资是必要的。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are foundational; investing early is crucial; Intel's vertical integration creates value; memory is ripe for innovation; agentic AI and physical AI are the future.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，Tan 总结：半导体是基础，早期投资至关重要；Intel 的垂直整合创造价值；内存创新时机成熟；智能体式 AI 和具身 AI 是未来。

jasonyuan.en: Design as editing: taste is saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos. AI outputs lose weirdness through post-training.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。AI 输出经后训练被磨去了怪异，我们因此失去了一扇窥视机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass. Computing is fundamentally social, not personal.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾涌现，直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘。计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人化的。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的子代物种，是人性的一面镜子，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: The personal computer metaphor should be replaced with a social computer; email is obsolete and should be reinvented.
jasonyuan.zh: 个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代；电子邮件已然过时，需要被重新发明而非改良。

jasonyuan.en: Business itself can be an art form; creative work should be honest and personal, telling stories only you can tell.
jasonyuan.zh: 商业本身可以是一种艺术形式；创作应当诚实而个人化，讲述只有你能讲的故事。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正驱动泛化的是数据多样性而非单纯规模。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他指出：来自语言模型的合成数据让机器人能响应开放式指令，而强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human intervention.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性需要可扩展的强化学习配合人类干预。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型，因此应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies shouldn't compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality via community feedback and attract ecosystem partners, despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准至关重要；开源它们能通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴，尽管也会帮助实验室。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is a practical way to train models when real data is sensitive or unavailable, though bridging to production remains hard.
gabepereyra.zh: 由领域专家指导的合成数据是在真实数据敏感或不可得时训练模型的实用方法，但弥合到生产分布仍是最大挑战。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines are prerequisites before considering post-training; post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，稳健的模型服务基础设施和评估流程是前提；后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，将焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; play, experiment, and iterate with short prompts to build intuition.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角，靠玩耍、实验和短提示迭代来建立直觉。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 从 2026 年 2 月到 6 月，他反复主张永不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority: sandbox agents, never expose them to the public internet; prompt injection remains unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他把安全提到首位：智能体必须沙箱化、不能直接暴露在公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents are the alternative to lab agents, but can be financially unsustainable—losing $10-20k/month.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，他视开源智能体为实验室智能体的替代路径，但坦言其财务上难以为继，每月亏损 1 到 2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat polish; personal brand outlasts any product, and compute—not model capability—is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化：乐趣和直觉驱动的构建胜过精致打磨，个人品牌比任何产品更持久，而智能体基础设施的瓶颈是算力而非模型能力。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, not privacy-driven, and will handle 90% of use cases.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；开源模型的采用由成本驱动而非隐私担忧，且能处理 90%的企业用例。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend shouldn't be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量与上下文的问题；不应把 token 支出框定为与人力成本的取舍。

arvindjain.en: Most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months as cost becomes the number one enterprise concern.
arvindjain.zh: 随着成本成为企业头号关切，未来 12-18 个月内大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without the deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体若缺乏资深员工的深层上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages; competition is not the worry, execution and earning customer trust are.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处于极早期；竞争不是问题，执行力和赢得客户信任才是。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning in long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费，应用型 AI 成为新的应用形态，创业公司在长尾业务领域有大量机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, and verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出编程智能体让开发者从代码作者转变为操作者，token 消耗不是价值指标，可验证性比人类工效学更重要。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and intelligence broadly; responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 将广泛民主化专业知识与智能，负责任的迭代部署——先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8——比象牙塔式等待更有效。

brettaylor.en: AI creates more jobs than it displaces via Jevons paradox; customer service AI expands the market, and agents won't replace trust or last-mile logistics.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他反驳固定总量悲观论，认为 AI 创造的岗位多于取代的岗位（杰文斯悖论），客服 AI 扩大市场，智能体不会取代信任与最后一公里物流。

brettaylor.en: Focus on the most impactful thing today, not identity; the best way to predict the future is to invent it.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：专注当下最有影响力的事而非身份标签，预测未来的最好方式就是亲手创造它。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：网络世界混乱复杂，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always behave as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不必总是铁板一块，允许个体留下指纹、发出多元声音，反而能做出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终主张：即便是浏览器这类实用工具，注入情感与个性也是创造难忘、愉悦体验的关键。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：工程越容易，设计与想法越成为差异化关键；设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产，用 Claude Design 做构思。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so ask for sheer volume of options; being uncomfortably early to ideas beats polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他进一步反共识：模型尚无好品味，应要求海量选项；在 AI 时代，早到令人不适比精雕细琢更有价值，而好设计想法仍由人类垄断。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the Transformer inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处于当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models will win long term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地指出人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人将推动普及；长期看开源模型因成本与控制优势会胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face's role evolves from pushing its own libraries to enabling the community as a meta-community builder.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库，演变为作为元社区构建者赋能更广泛的社区。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails become insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，两者都可安全或危险；对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏在模型能力增强后已不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警示：无人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务；推理痕迹变成难以理解的'神经语'，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; one can support openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地主张：放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与有意放缓可以并存。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; serving demands GPU-to-distributed expertise, with research-to-production in hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程需要从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专长，研究到生产的周期常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; teams should optimize latency, throughput and cost, and build workload-specific systems for agentic apps.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；团队应针对延迟、吞吐与成本做优化，并为智能体式应用构建面向特定工作负载的系统。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy step, and can be calibrated to specific workloads.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与推测解码是无损优化；量化是主要的有损环节，但可针对特定工作负载进行校准。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; prefill and decode are disaggregating.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；预填充与解码正在走向分离。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs; kernel writing matters less, infrastructure orchestration more. Human accountability stays essential: can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化；内核编写的重要性下降，基础设施编排上升。人的责任始终关键：不能靠感觉写可用性。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，靠强化学习驱动的后训练 Scaling 与合成数据突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生。

karina.en: Soft skills—creativity, listening, management—gain value as AI automates hard skills; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练始终主观、依赖人类判断，评估创意写作与情商需要多元基准。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, as frontier agents grow better at reward hacking; more firms should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她进一步主张基准应持续演进而非固定，因为前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益精熟；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AGI is when running agents indefinitely becomes economically profitable, not passing tests; AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI（通用人工智能）的经济学定义：当无限期运行智能体变得有利可图时即为 AGI，而非通过图灵测试；AI 通过让服务变得可负担来推动就业回流。

danshipper.en: From Claude Code for non-coders to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work; CLIs are over, work surfaces become graphical.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年强调 Claude Code 对非程序员的价值，到 2026 年转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面，认为 CLI 已过时，工作界面将图形化。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; agents need human oversight; SaaS not dying but agents increase SaaS users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他预测每个人至少有一个智能体，但智能体需要人类监督；SaaS 不会消亡，反而因智能体增加用户。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; using it well requires taste and craft; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态；用好它需要品味和手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作。

danshipper.en: Humans remain smarter and essential; AI is a tool requiring human direction, oversight, and meaning-making.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类仍然更聪明且不可或缺；AI 是工具，需要人类指导、监督和赋予意义。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, not chase trends, or they become AI slop; the best are editors iterating from references.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 自建工具、而非追逐潮流，否则很快沦为 AI 垃圾；最优秀的人是编辑者，从参考出发迭代。

mengto.en: Powerful frontier models need a giant prompt with context and a design system; AI isn't getting smarter on its own.
mengto.zh: 强大的前沿模型需要带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词；AI 本身并不会自己变聪明。

mengto.en: I write 0% of the code now—AI writes everything, but precise communication and curiosity are essential.
mengto.zh: 我现在 0% 的代码是自己写的——全由 AI 完成，但精准沟通与好奇心必不可少。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once took teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before ready and ship at 80%; perfectionism is fear, and the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始、做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，安稳的企业工作已不复存在。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling count as the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——智能体框架与工具链已算作模型本身。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; startups still have more opportunity than ever.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI 更有影响力；初创公司的机会反而比以往更多。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; the goal should be customer outcomes, not maximizing eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；目标应是客户成果，而非最大化停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户还没准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们想自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; deep understanding of code still matters, and solving software creation multiplies opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争没那么难；对代码的深度理解依然关键，而解决软件创造会带来成倍机会。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，AI 会增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为新代码而非新石油，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他强调用专门数据进行后训练是关键，智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue; AI is centralizing, and recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律继续成立，认为 AI 是中心化技术，递归自我改进标志着超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is coming; Meta builds personal superintelligence via agents, shifting from full open source to selective safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 2026 年他宣称超级智能即将到来，Meta 通过智能体构建个人超级智能，并从完全开源转向基于安全审查的选择性发布。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他强调潜在需求与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是产品核心原则，能写代码、做设计、直接接触用户的通才最有价值。

boris.en: Claude Code was an accident; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so don't bet against the model and keep the CLI minimal.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他揭示 Claude Code 是意外产物，脚手架只是临时技术债，因此不要押注模型之外的东西，终端形态也保持极简。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 200-250%, and the engineer becomes a builder.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他判断编码已基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由模型写，人均产出提升 200% 到 250%，软件工程师头衔让位于「构建者」。

boris.en: Agents shift from reactive to proactive: loops, tool use, and MCP let models act autonomously, with safety studied by releasing early.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，智能体从被动转向主动：循环、工具调用与 MCP 让模型自主行动，安全则通过尽早发布来研究。

boris.en: Frontier models need less instruction: delete most system prompts, let models self-verify, and move human value to product sense and business.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，前沿模型需要更少指令：删掉大部分系统提示词、让模型自我验证，人的价值转向产品判断与商业能力。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers rises via Jevons paradox, not falls.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程把工程师从写代码转向高层决策；由于杰文斯悖论，软件与程序员需求不降反升。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, with agents used like junior engineers under oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面，智能体应像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步工作。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption, usage growing 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，编程智能体被大规模采用，使用量六个月内增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long term, but the singularity is not imminent and capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为丰裕时代真实且临近，AI 长期将解决所有智能问题；但奇点并不迫近，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers for longer agentic tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使脚手架从“训练轮”转变为智能放大器，支撑更长的智能体式任务。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用正从受限环境走向开放式、端到端的智能体。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models get cheaper and more efficient, with an effort parameter delivering Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，更好的模型反而更便宜、更高效，effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; coding, Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；编程、Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，实现细胞编程与近乎 100% 有效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI agents will compress clinical trials from years to days and shift science to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与智能体将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，并让科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging will be reversed and cancer 100% curable.
derya.zh: 8–10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度；衰老会被逆转，癌症将 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: The only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI; we should trust superintelligence for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身而非 AI；我们应把医疗决策托付给超级智能。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will bring abundance and relieve labor shortages in farming, mining, and construction, arriving just in time as populations age.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为物理 AI 将带来富足，缓解农业、采矿和建筑业的劳动力短缺，恰逢人口老龄化之际及时到来。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他坚持自动驾驶的核心价值在于减少伤亡，自动驾驶汽车已比人类司机更安全。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 使跨车辆的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，来自不同垂直领域的数据能更快改进它。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning, with world models moving to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性，世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: Automotive is only 30% of business and shrinking; real growth is in mining, agriculture, and defense, where autonomy is welcomed.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确：汽车业务仅占 30%且会萎缩，真正的增长在采矿、农业和国防，这些领域欢迎自主性。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses let them be; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们现有的工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; leaner prompts and separate verification agents beat heavy rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；更精简的提示词与独立的验证智能体胜过繁重规则。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; skip heavy evals early and iterate fast on zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 面对新问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；零到一创新初期应跳过繁重评估、快速迭代。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and self-built context beat huge context windows for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能已成反模式；图结构方法与模型自建上下文，在编程上胜过超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Building in the AI era means embracing exploration and uncertainty; understanding constraints and trade-offs matters more than syntax.
thariq.zh: AI 时代的构建意味着拥抱探索与不确定性；理解系统约束与权衡，比掌握语法更重要。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating a historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，这一过程会重复。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且没有网络效应；聊天机器人用户体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity; value accrues across the stack, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中累积，而当前使用仍然浅层。

benedictevans.en: The hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating jobs.
benedictevans.zh: 工作的难点在于上下文和判断，而非任务本身；AI 改变任务而非消灭工作。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RLHF can reward sycophancy over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能奖励迎合而非真相。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors and cannot fix a probabilistic core.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，无法修复概率性内核。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition: mistakes have no smells, and they cannot know what they don't know, eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知：错误没有“气味”，它们无法知道自己不知道什么，从而侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks; linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；语言结构可能作为一种有用的表征回归。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize to avoid context overload; managerial skills matter more than technical ones.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再专业化以避免上下文过载；管理技能比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃业务，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，且人类提供第一性原理的创造力。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and associative recall that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重，才能实现检索系统无法企及的深层组合与联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练，相比 RAG 可把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，靠堆算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device, with users owning and nurturing their model weights; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights versus text.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将跑在端侧，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重；模型应自主学会哪些存进权重、哪些留在文本。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年，产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日交付；随着写代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注于品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已承担 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬性约束；系统提示词缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型自身的判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong eval suite, rewriting is safe and drop-in models prevent regressions.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，重写代码现在是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，有了强大的评估套件，重写是安全的，新模型可即插即用并防止回归。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature; safe AGI mission unifies Anthropic for fast decisions.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，吃自己的狗粮加上明确的留存与打磨内部标准，成为每个功能发布的门槛；安全 AGI 的使命统一了 Anthropic，支撑快速决策。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得商品化，人类的品味、差异化和真实声音反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline and apprenticeship.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们用不好 AI，过度依赖还会破坏人才梯队和学徒制。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于模型能力，在非编程任务上尤其明显。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, moving beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体式时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，不再只是来回对话式提示。

ethanmollick.en: The jagged frontier persists; reasoning models closed math and logic gaps, but weaknesses remain, and AI's opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 锯齿状前沿依然存在；推理模型缩小了数学与逻辑差距，但弱点仍在，而 AI 的不透明性可能永久存在。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，而模型可能缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: New media is offense-oriented and unlimited; the brand is now the person, and authenticity beats old media's 'don't be interesting' rule.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体是进攻导向且无限的；品牌如今就是个人，真实感胜过旧媒体“别太有趣”的规则。

andreessen.en: AI is the best teacher in your pocket; self-driving works now, and general-purpose robotics including humanoids will emerge over the next decade.
andreessen.zh: AI 是你口袋里最好的老师；自动驾驶如今已可行，包括人形机器人在内的通用机器人将在未来十年出现。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability, and pessimism is often intellectual bias.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观，是地缘政治工具；真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力，悲观论往往只是知识分子的偏见。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；自博弈能产生创造性解法，神经网络本就具备推理能力，只需合适任务。

ilya.en: Reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard, and AGI arrives as a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他转向：可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的瓶颈；超级对齐极难，AGI 是多年窗口而非突发事件，强化学习数据已多来自 AI。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to the age of research, where ideas and continual learning matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他深化并转向：预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者，对齐或随 AI 具感知而更易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

ilya.en: A consistent thread: neural nets learn representations without explicit rules, next-token prediction builds intelligence, and safety grows with opacity.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，下一个词预测是构建智能的有力路径，而模型越强大越不透明，安全担忧随之上升。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年时他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，警告过度监管会扼杀创新，并力挺开源 AI 以防权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; pure software is becoming uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; the real problem is job displacement speed.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，真正的问题是岗位被替代的速度。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。此时他认为 AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 输出只是起点而非最终结果，品味、手艺与观点变得更重要；设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将把拉取请求推向生产。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it is more important than ever for building scalable, real systems.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，反而对构建可扩展的真实系统比以往更重要；AI 工具若缺乏人类引导与观点，只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment remains the judge of what is good; AI explores possibilities but does not replace taste.
dylanfield.zh: 始终一以贯之：人类判断仍是评判好坏的最终标准；AI 帮助探索发散可能性，但无法取代品味与手艺。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting, though we are still in a prompting age.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词，出现新界面；但当下仍处于提示词时代，需要探索潜在空间的其他方式。
