aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and obsession beats credentials.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，热爱与深度学习比博士学位更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程像 Minecraft 一样天花板无限，远未解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and power is the bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你做事而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标，电力是 AI 基础设施的最大瓶颈。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create value, and companies should be built with far fewer people.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真实商业价值，公司应以远更少的人配合 AI 智能体来构建。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions, and local AI can counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励提出好问题，本地 AI 模型可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares weights, while agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而永生、能共享知识，而智能体天然会追求控制、规避关停。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; the mind is not a theater, and Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong—language is learned from data.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持并强化反共识：AI 已具备主观体验，心智不是内在剧场；乔姆斯基式先天句法观是错的，语言是从数据中学来的建模媒介。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; agents develop self-preservation as a subgoal, so alignment must take priority over raw capability.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能 20 年内出现，智能体会把自我保存作为子目标，因此对齐研究必须优先于单纯提升能力。

hinton.en: Regulation should steer, not brake; AI will disrupt jobs and needs UBI, and should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他转向治理与价值：监管应是方向盘而非刹车，AI 将冲击就业、需要全民基本收入，并应被训练得像母亲一样有爱，而非只是智能助手。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents; verification, not generation, becomes the bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；当代码生成加速后，验证而非生成成为新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Speed enables mid-turn steering and replaces deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他强调速度带来实时交互与中途转向，让模型驱动动作取代确定性步骤。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is cheap; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队须从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still fails at design because taste is hard to grade; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分；原型与生产代码转而成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, but specialties persist; models should get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他承认角色在坍缩，但专业分工仍在；模型应更擅长删除代码，而不只是增加复杂度。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他仍把 OpenAI 定位为纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练与缩放定律没有死，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end AI research.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并给出具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in the next 1-2 years as models become more capable.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: AI can solve many open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他转向数学领域，认为 AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones; research taste still matters.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他再次重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域出色，但在主观领域吃力；研究品味仍不可替代。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他强调深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他判断单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与更好的世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模是分布外泛化的关键。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment is worsening with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction AI.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他警告对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，即便 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，必须构建天生安全的 AI。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出科学家 AI：非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并回避强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，编码与智能体式能力按缩放定律兑现；创业者应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and agency remain essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的角色从助手推进到协作者再到自主同事；小团队因此获得杠杆，但人类验证与用户能动性始终不可让渡。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them, and rewriting is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切；难点从加功能变成砍功能，而借助 AI，重写软件从数年缩短到数天。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back on feedback to show real judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调长周期任务委托加验证闭环重新定义生产力；模型应敢于反驳反馈以展现真正判断力，而非一味附和。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; safety concerns are genuine, not marketing.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他称 Anthropic Labs 致力于弥合模型能力与实际产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多能动性与自我认知；并强调公司的安全关切是真实的，不是营销。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation discipline to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调通过训练/验证/测试划分来避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，我们已进入后架构阶段，AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; four safety categories; agent security and prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要显式训练和额外层，不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；安全涵盖错误、有害使用、社会影响和失控四类；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability ≠ robustness; lethal trifecta for prompt injection; enterprise security demand.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素需要同时满足；企业采用编码智能体推动 AI 安全需求。

kolter.en: Architecture matters less than data and Scaling; evaluation and security require explicit effort, not just bigger models.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：架构不如数据和 Scaling（规模扩张）重要；评估与安全需要显式努力，而非仅靠更大模型。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具加速科学家而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；信任将像互联网信任一样发展，社会会学会驾驭它。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove its success; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough, and interpretability isn't necessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张），是许多中等胜利而非单一突破，且可解释性对有用的科学 AI 并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: AI in biology needs new curated datasets like the PDB for other modalities; AlphaFold enables resource-limited scientists to do previously impossible experiments.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他展望生物学 AI 需要像 PDB 一样为其他模态构建新策展数据集；AlphaFold 使资源有限的科学家能完成此前不可能的实验。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; design must balance technology with human needs, and tech should arrive gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，设计要平衡技术与人的需求，技术应逐步引入让社会适应。

fadell.en: Between chapters, embrace boredom and failure; storytelling and self-care are foundational, and optimism comes from changing your media diet.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他主张在人生章节之间拥抱无聊与失败，讲故事与自我照顾是根基，乐观来自改变信息摄入。

fadell.en: Start from a painkiller, write the press release first, and make opinion-based decisions for v1; beginners beat experts on novel problems.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他提出：从止痛药式痛点出发，先写新闻稿，v1 靠观点而非数据决策；面对新问题，初学者心态胜过专家。

fadell.en: Climate and deep tech need early investment; zig while others zag, and build hardware-plus-software teams with staying power over hype.
fadell.zh: 2022 到 2026 年，他坚持气候与深科技要提前投资，别人恐惧时逆向布局，做有持久力的软硬结合团队而非追逐炒作。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and humans in the loop; wearables will be a federated set, not one device, with the smartphone still central.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 需要传感器上下文与人类在环，可穿戴将是一组联邦式设备而非单一设备，智能手机仍是核心。

ivyross.en: Design should target unarticulated needs; intuition is intelligence, not inferior to data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，她主张设计应针对未被言说的需求，直觉是一种智能，并不低于数据。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; machines have sensors but no sensory systems; art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，她深化为自然是最好的设计师，机器有传感器但没有感觉系统，艺术是良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; intuition uses subconscious data; AI makes creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，她进一步提出创造力在约束下繁荣，直觉基于潜意识数据，AI 让创造技能更有价值。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design, intuition, and sensory experience remain her consistent core across all talks.
ivyross.zh: 贯穿始终的是，以人为本的设计、直觉与感官体验是她所有访谈中一以贯之的核心。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via dogfooding, live one-on-ones, trust-and-verify, and kindness as strategy; war rooms need realistic timelines.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力靠吃自己的狗粮、实时一对一、信任并验证，把善意当战略；作战室要设定现实周期，而非几周速胜。

fiona.en: By May 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so norms and roadmaps must go just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此团队规范与路线图必须转向即时化。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to JIT; design docs give way to PRs, and AI settles technical debates by generating multiple PRs.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR，技术争论靠 AI 生成多个 PR 来定夺。

fiona.en: Code becomes source of truth; docs sync to code with AI help, code ownership turns fuzzy, and old processes get audited and killed.
fiona.zh: 代码成为唯一事实来源；文档借 AI 与代码同步，代码归属变模糊，旧流程被审计并淘汰。

fiona.en: Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth; orgs stay flat, managers start as ICs to dogfood and gain street cred.
fiona.zh: 招聘偏向有产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者；组织尽量扁平，管理者从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮并建立一线信誉。

fiona.en: By June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性配高问责、成长型思维与验证框架最为关键。

fiona.en: Agents blur roles as PMs ship code; flow-state joy fades, satisfaction comes from product impact, and next-gen engineers need apprenticeship.
fiona.zh: 智能体模糊角色边界，PM 也能交付代码；心流之乐消退，满足感来自产品影响，下一代工程师需要学徒制培养。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）植入的。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product needing fault-tolerant UI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品；机器学习产品必须设计容错界面，让 UI 匹配算法能力。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; inference marginal cost will force business-model change.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他深化判断：生成式 AI 让产品变成双向、对话式、对称的交互；而推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，这是传统软件没有的。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must reposition, rebuild infrastructure, and expose data via APIs and MCP.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 类比智能手机级别的宏观转变：企业必须重新定位、重建基础设施，并通过 API 与 MCP 暴露公司数据，让非开发者也能用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not more addiction; strategy is 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步转向：AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法，而非让人更上瘾；Spotify 的战略是“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度指标。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and grounding in the physical world is necessary for common sense. Scaling alone won't solve AI's lack of common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，物理世界的 grounding 是常识的基础；他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决当前 AI 缺乏常识的问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction. Text alone is insufficient for AGI; vision provides richer world information. World models are learned, not hardwired.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能的本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息；世界模型是习得的而非硬编码的。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence due to lack of world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning. JEPA and open source are essential; AGI will be gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 因缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划而无法达到人类水平智能；JEPA 和开源至关重要；AGI（通用人工智能）将是渐进过程而非突然事件。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; they lack world models and physical understanding. Next breakthrough requires non-generative architectures like JEPA; human-level intelligence within 10 years but harder than thought.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 不如家猫智能，因其缺乏世界模型和物理理解；下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式架构；人类水平智能将在 10 年内实现，但比想象中更难。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning and safety. The next decade is robotics; open research and objective-driven AI are key.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类水平 AI 的死胡同；在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现规划与安全；下一个十年属于机器人；开放研究和目标驱动 AI 是关键。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾早期：Scaling（规模扩张）与专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署是学习与对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and public safety work are essential.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此负责任开发与公开的安全工作至关重要。

murati.en: From iterative deployment to keeping humans in the loop, alignment must be done in public with feedback.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：从迭代部署到保持人类在环，对齐必须在公开反馈中推进。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for steering AI.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她深化治理观：引导 AI 发展，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine combining generation and verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建一个结合生成与验证的自我改进推理引擎，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems work together.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行；可靠证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors, and extends beyond safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了扩展卓越，而非仅仅消除错误，其市场远超安全关键等小众领域。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and tokens matter as much as model size; open source drives safety through scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和 token 数量与模型规模同样重要；开源通过广泛审查推动安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with human-in-the-loop augmentation.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并以人类在环增强工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization, and agentic platforms with human validation.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他进一步判断：模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与带人类验证的智能体平台。

mensch.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy remain consistent threads across his thinking.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主，这三点在其思考中一以贯之。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调推理模型通过思维链和强化学习能在同等算力下带来更大提升。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力促使业界转向更小、更便宜的模型，蒸馏而非技术极限才是预训练规模扩张放缓的原因。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他持续强调泛化仍是核心挑战，仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型需要穷尽表面模式才能学到概念，而人类能从少量样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对强化学习的看法：它能跨领域泛化但存在锯齿边缘，需要仔细监督；同时编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Open source models will persist for sovereignty reasons; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他转向更务实的风险观：开源模型因主权原因将持续存在，系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox enables safe autonomy.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱让它在无需批准下安全自主。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files make hyper-personalized automation easy; scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能以 markdown 文件即可创建，让超个性化自动化变得简单；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性在下降。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, fire off work asynchronously, and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 让 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，异步派发工作，只以最终影响来评判。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of learning into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年的学习压缩到几周。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative presence.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，并强调虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共创的价值。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and care are consistent threads: protect fragile ideas, resist status quo, and design with love as gratitude.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，好奇心与关怀是贯穿始终的主线：保护脆弱创意、抵抗现状，并以爱设计作为对人类的感恩。

jonyive.en: Simplicity deepens from removing clutter to expressing essence with joy and humanity; speed and quality need not conflict.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他对简洁的理解从去除杂乱深化为以喜悦和人性表达本质，并认为速度与质量未必冲突。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate, not worship ashes; authenticity matters, so Ferrari's EV rejects fake engine sounds and redefines performance.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他强调设计必须创新而非崇拜灰烬，真实性至关重要，因此法拉利电动车拒绝模拟引擎声并重新定义性能。

jonyive.en: He now argues against touchscreens in cars, favoring physical controls for safety—a shift from his earlier touchscreen advocacy.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他转而反对汽车中的触摸屏，主张为安全保留物理控制，这与他早年推广触摸屏的立场形成转变。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI systems: memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck, so batch size and sparsity drive latency-cost tradeoffs.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统：瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力，因此批大小与稀疏度决定了延迟与成本的权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, now governs deployment economics.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为如今决定部署经济性的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation stems from the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention eases KV cache but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口的停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能缓解 KV 缓存压力，但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为削减这种搬运而存在。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically: FP4 can be 3x FP8 throughput, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来平方级收益：FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而 GPU 本质上只是许多微型 TPU 拼接而成。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models. Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型；推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，可提升推理并突破预训练极限。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 与现代 LLM 不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会令模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练与强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from solutions and intuition, not rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；优秀作品源于解决方案与直觉，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了调研—发散—收敛流程；设计师减少做原型，转而帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks to 3-6 months; trust is built through speed, shipping early and iterating fast.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野缩短到 3-6 个月；信任靠速度建立，尽早发布、快速迭代。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋型应届生。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are the real value.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威和与模糊共处才是真正价值。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR unlocks reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励强化学习三阶段；数据质量胜过算法选择，RLVR 能解锁思维链等推理行为。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理扩展曲线是陷阱；更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律对预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完；增量现在来自后训练与推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, though they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他预测开放模型将驱动未来十年 AI 研究，但最佳开放模型仍落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月；中国实验室在开放度上领先。

askell.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待它们：成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; give a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Model welfare matters partly because it shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 模型福祉之所以重要，部分原因在于它会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike and unique.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，这使它像一个孩子，是一种独特的存在。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, explicit guidance should shrink and judgment grow; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少、判断空间应扩大；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with many knobs, yet Scaling and next-token prediction yield emergent in-context learning; vision suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为神经网络只是带很多旋钮的简单数学表达式，但通过 Scaling（规模扩张）和下一个词预测，会涌现出上下文学习等能力；并主张仅靠视觉就足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is future but entropy must be kept; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他深化为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机、能带来干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉端到端路线正确；认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; LLMs are operating systems with jagged intelligence; decade of agents, keep AI on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有锯齿状智能；这是智能体的十年而非一年，应给 AI 拴上缰绳、小步快跑。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw; synthetic data collapses without entropy.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督信号；合成数据缺乏熵会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Since December I haven't typed code, delegating to agents; bottleneck is skill in directing them; vibe coding raises floor, agentic engineering keeps quality.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他称自去年 12 月起不再手写代码、全部委托给智能体；瓶颈从打字速度变为指挥智能体的技能；氛围编程抬高下限，智能体式工程守住专业质量。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward can close it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，而机器学习系统恰恰缺失这一点；主张用好奇心驱动、无目标探索，并以模型分歧作为内在奖励来提升样本效率。

pathak.en: RL's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robotics needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization.
pathak.zh: 同年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，真实机器人任务需要样本效率、动态动作空间和跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: From modular motor policies and neural dynamic policies to a general-purpose brain: the goal remains zero-shot generalization across morphologies and tasks.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年的模块化运动策略与神经动态策略，到 2026 年提出通用机器人大脑，主线始终是跨形态、跨任务的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real-world data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他将机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此必须用视频和模拟数据做预训练，再用真实世界数据做后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; robotics cannot scale like software and needs rigorous testing and a data flywheel.
pathak.zh: 他进一步深化：部署本身是核心技术挑战而非单纯商业问题，机器人无法像软件一样快速扩张，需要严格测试和跨垂直领域的数据飞轮。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress; alignment is pressing; iterative deployment mitigates risk.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他视 AGI（通用人工智能）为一系列里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，对齐是紧迫挑战，迭代部署可缓解风险。

pachocki.en: AI safety progress is now guaranteed by capability needs, not just ethics; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求保障而非仅靠伦理，并指出能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后。

pachocki.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may mean we are close; early OpenAI had impostor syndrome and awkward vibes.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这可能意味着我们已接近；早期 OpenAI 有冒名顶替综合征和尴尬氛围。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone is sufficient, specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他视持续学习为核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；并反共识地认为仅靠强化学习就足够，专门持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability; alignment optimism increased despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链监控是关键对齐工具，隐藏思维链可保留可解释性价值；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪却增加。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; modern tools make them interpretable, and scaling current approaches solves driving without new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 到 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的自动驾驶栈，现代工具已让端到端具备可解释性，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, echoing AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 2025 年他强调世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，认为完美模拟器等于解决自动驾驶，类比 AlphaGo 的路径。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: zero-shot across 500+ cities via diverse data, curriculum learning, and synthetic data for efficiency.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把泛化视为核心目标：靠多样数据、课程学习与合成数据实现跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化，并提升数据效率。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; camera-only reaches human level but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为语言集成改善表征、推理与人机交互；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: Shift in emphasis: infrastructure and data quality now matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles outscale robotaxis, and AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心发生转变：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；量产车将比 Robotaxi 更快上量，AV 3.0 或把智能移出车外，经网状网络甚至取消红绿灯。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 真正进步的驱动力；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM，若没有超越下一个词预测的新范式，可能无法实现。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model will rule all, so every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，因此每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and Elo benchmarks steers AI toward slop; labs ignoring them perform better.
edwinchen.zh: 为参与度和 Elo 基准优化会把 AI 引向垃圾内容；忽视这些基准的实验室反而表现更好。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; AI must prioritize safety over accuracy, as omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断比以往更重要；AI 必须优先考虑安全而非准确，因为遗漏是关键风险。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; chat is not the final interface—it's like MS-DOS, and the model is the product to iterate like software.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，聊天不是最终界面，它像 MS-DOS；模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision evolves from a personalized AI assistant to a proactive, affordance-rich super assistant that amplifies human capability.
turley.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的愿景从个性化 AI 助手深化为主动、富含可供性的超级助手，以放大人类能力。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, driven by one-third friction removal, one-third core product, one-third model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他指出 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，由三分之一消除摩擦、三分之一核心产品、三分之一模型改进驱动。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve; unlimited plans may become unsustainable, and curiosity is the most important skill in the AI era.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他认为定价将演变，无限计划可能不可持续；好奇心是 AI 时代最重要的技能。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow apps; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME, FunSearch, AlphaGeometry show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 要解决“根节点”问题而非窄应用：AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 都体现广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现；AI 必须被逼着泛化，而不是记忆。

kohli.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale; material science impact will take 5-10 years.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张 DeepMind 避开顶尖高校能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题；材料科学影响还需 5-10 年。

kohli.en: AlphaGo combined intuition and search; Move 37 showed AI can go beyond human knowledge, later extended via AlphaZero and AlphaTensor.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 结合直觉与搜索，第 37 手显示 AI 能超越人类知识，后经 AlphaZero 与 AlphaTensor 延续。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning and verifiable domains like code are key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他判断大模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；后训练中的强化学习与代码等可验证领域才是关键。

carlpei.en: Build a brand by uniting teams on purpose; start simple, survive, and let quality create hype rather than chasing it.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调：品牌是把所有团队凝聚在更高目标上并一致执行；创业公司应先从简单产品证明自己，生存是核心价值，好产品与稳定品质自然带来热度，而非为炒作而炒作。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic software; AI models commoditize, so applied AI and trust matter more than hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向认为手机的未来在于生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件，而非硬件大改；大语言模型趋于商品化，应用型 AI 与信任、安全才是关键，硬件长期利润最低，必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; ban the word AI and treat it as an ingredient for elegant user pain-point solutions, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他反复强调：多数 AI 是胡扯，在解决不存在的问题；产品讨论中应禁用“AI”一词，把 AI 当作像屏幕一样的成分，价值来自优雅解决用户痛点的体验。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; marketing is arbitrage, and the smartphone dies only to brain-computer interfaces, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化为：成熟品类中设计是最快的差异化手段，营销是套利；智能手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口能终结它，同时应用将消失、公司应为智能体开放 API。

carlpei.en: Stay alive and pace yourself; challengers win through efficient marketing arbitrage, community, and optimism, not by copying giants.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：生存优先、控制节奏；挑战者靠高效的营销套利、社区参与和乐观雄心取胜，而非模仿巨头，欧洲的停滞是周期性的，困境反而孕育韧性。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; RL is only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型比作操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: The data bottleneck in robotics persists; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the scalable future.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调机器人领域的数据瓶颈，并认为来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据是可扩展的未来方向。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is ~5 years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：一个能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后到来。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains the hardest; robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出：系统二（推理）进展顺利，但系统一（低层控制）仍是具身 AI 最难的部分；到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为像 Gato 这样把所有输入 token 化的通才智能体是迈向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: Agents should learn from YouTube video, not just teleoperation; language may emerge via deception as in nature.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张智能体应像人一样从 YouTube 视频学习，而非只靠遥操作数据；并认为语言在 AI 中的涌现可能像自然界一样需要智能体互相欺骗。

nando.en: Large models excite but aren't everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, even outside Scaling.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他提醒大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，根本性创新可以来自任何地方，不局限于 Scaling（规模扩张）。

nando.en: Goal is AI creating new symbols and knowledge, like Einstein's thought experiments, augmenting scientists and laborers.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终把目标定为能创造新符号与知识的 AI，如爱因斯坦的思想实验，去增强科学家与劳动者。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当今最大挑战，并承认我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps; local-language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲跳过了遗留问题与性别差距，本地语言模型可彻底改变教育。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence. Most intelligence is pattern matching; fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升模型智能；大部分智能是模式匹配，随着长上下文与自适应算力，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; reliability, not capability, is the bar for agents. Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他转向以可验证奖励的强化学习为核心突破：智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; coding is the leading indicator. Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴，认为编程是 AI 进展的领先指标；Transformer 足够通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需全新架构。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing. Compute is the bottleneck; inference compute will limit capable agents by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级而非停滞：算力是瓶颈，推理算力到 2028 年将限制可用智能体的数量。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration matters more than raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents. World models are not on the critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型存在巨大能力盈余，编排比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理智能体集群；世界模型不在通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns and chase ROI on perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，而应复用熟悉模式，只在值得的地方追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; ship fast, iterate, and empower designers with ownership.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终认为速度与决断胜过完美：快速发布、迭代，并赋予设计师自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮助公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool and quality signal.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具与质量信号。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈,引导工程师并对齐问题;把 AI 当作创意伙伴,开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务:它会波动,需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作的,以代码为唯一事实来源;90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: AI-first companies collapse and merge entire functions—PM, research, sales—while design and engineering become two sides of one coin.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 优先的公司会让 PM、研究、销售等整个职能坍缩合并,而设计与工程变成同一枚硬币的两面。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps outperform specialists; not adopting AI is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才胜过专才;不采用 AI 就像早期无视互联网一样。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training and RLHF are crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction misaligns with human learning.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她强调预训练提供广博知识，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全、友好回应的关键；她反共识地认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can let smaller models match larger ones, challenging brute-force scaling.
yejin.zh: 同样在 2023 年，她提出推理阶段的算法（如 top-k 采样、神经逻辑解码）与经批评模型过滤的高质量合成数据，能让更小的模型比肩大模型，挑战了暴力式 Scaling（规模扩张）的路线。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge, and RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把数据视为根本瓶颈，认为当前方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越；并反共识地指出，RLVR 在 best-of-n 提升的同时可能拉低 pass@k，强化学习需要精细工程才能胜过监督微调。

yejin.en: Abductive reasoning and open, cross-institution collaboration are needed to explore knowledge beyond the human internet.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她进一步主张，溯因推理是超越归纳与演绎的科学发现关键，且需要开放、跨机构的协作，才能探索人类互联网知识之外的未知领域，与封闭的前沿模型实验室竞争。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data, RL during pre-training, and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger frontier models.
yejin.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化为：借助高质量、多样化的合成数据、在预训练中引入强化学习以奖励信息增益，以及多元对齐，小语言模型可以超越更大的前沿模型；她并反共识地指出前沿模型内部与彼此之间同质化严重，去偏互联网不可能，多元对齐才是出路。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research. Alignment and robustness need empirical study.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议先积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究；对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs. Need scalable oversight, interpretability, automated alignment. Evaluation easier than generation; train deceptive models as model organisms.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐；评估比生成更容易，应主动训练欺骗性模型作为模式生物来研究防御。

leike.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone insufficient. Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；后训练无法单独解决 AGI 对齐；需要第三方测试和 SB 1047 等监管。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically tractable and may be easier than thought; biggest risk is uncertainty about true alignment, not misalignment itself.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对齐在实证上可解，可能比想象中容易；最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是无法确定系统是否真正对齐。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the main way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding and are poorly calibrated.
truell.zh: 2024 年他强调基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而难以找 bug、校准也很差——这是对评测与模型能力的清醒怀疑。

truell.en: Programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他把编程的未来从写代码推进到更高层的意图表达，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models become essential to every magic moment; the AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：自研定制模型成为每个“魔法时刻”的关键，并判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开——从工具视角升维到时代判断。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes AI smarter, but neural networks remain alchemy-like black boxes.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）用更多算力和数据让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术一样不可知。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need much longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他转向强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）来实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling will drive progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI, and open-source models are catching up to frontier models.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：测试时算力扩展会推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI；智能体式能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要，开源模型正在追赶前沿模型。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data, along with algorithmic advances, is the core driver of AI progress; dialogue and coding are underhyped killer applications.
shazeer.zh: 始终，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据加上算法进步是 AI 进步的核心驱动力；对话和编程是被低估的杀手级应用。

shazeer.en: From focusing on training-time scaling and next-token prediction to emphasizing inference-time compute, agentic capabilities, and continual learning with modular components.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 年关注训练时 Scaling（规模扩张）和下一个词预测，到 2025 年转向强调推理时算力、智能体式能力和模块化组件的持续学习。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL plus simulation can teach a robot tennis, and self-play gives strong signal.
abbeel.zh: 机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配；强化学习加模拟就能教机器人打网球，自对弈提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation, not be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency.
abbeel.zh: 先验知识应作用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks; minimal fine-tuning enables image classification and protein binding.
abbeel.zh: 预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式；仅需微调即可做图像分类与蛋白质结合预测。

abbeel.en: Real-world value demands 99.9% reliability; one neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 真实世界价值要求 99.9% 的可靠性；单个神经网络可泛化到不同仓储任务与末端执行器。

abbeel.en: The human brain's generality inspires AI, yet current AI remains far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real environments.
abbeel.zh: 人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用；好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。
